hero.subtitle: Right from your browser. No installation, no complex setup. Professional pixel art and animation tools are now at your fingertips.

features.subtitle: PixelRaj brings studio-grade tools directly to your browser. No installation, no complex setup.
features.f1_desc: Powered by WebGL for blazing-fast rendering, even on high-resolution canvases up to 4K.
features.f2_desc: Experiment freely with a top-tier layer management system, opacity, and blending modes.
features.f3_desc: Create moving game assets with an intuitive keyframe timeline, complete with onion skinning & live preview.
features.f4_desc: Fully cloud-based. Your work is always saved automatically and accessible from any device.

usecases.uc1_desc: Design retro game assets, tilemaps, to UI spritesheets with high pixel precision for your favorite engine.
usecases.uc2_desc: Express your digital artwork powered by custom brushes, automatic dithering, and iconic retro color palettes.
usecases.uc3_desc: Create lively moving characters equipped with a very lightweight and easy-to-understand animation timeline.

testimonials.subtitle: See how PixelRaj helps artists and developers bring their crazy ideas to life.
testimonials.t1_quote: "The real-time drawing experience on PixelRaj is truly incredible! There's no lag at all when I stroke the brush, very smooth for making my solo game assets."
testimonials.t2_quote: "This platform is amazing. I can create pixel art and animate it right here. The character assets I made are ready to be exported for my game engine needs!"
testimonials.t3_quote: "The editor's performance is very lightweight and most importantly, no delay! Stroke by stroke feels very instant, just like drawing in expensive native software."
